messages:
maria: Heads up — master CI is failing fast in the core-integ suite. Lots of tests timing out talking to auth-mock (502/connection reset). Job: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/core-integ/7823 :warning:
ci-bot: build #7823 failed — exit code 1 — junit report attached (link)
kev: ugh, saw a spike in auth-mock restarts around 02:14 UTC in the test cluster logs. Can someone check the mock pod events? :eyes:
sam: grabbing logs now. I see repeated liveness probe failures and then crashloop backoff. snippet:
```
E0324 02:13:57.123 auth-mock.go:212] upstream connection reset by peer
Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 502
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```
maria: that matches the failures. Tests hit the mock during setup and flake. Rerun passes about 60% of the time. Julie, did we merge the auth-mock change last night?
julie: I merged a tiny refactor to auth-mock on the feature branch but didn't touch startup logic. However, there was a dependency bump for the http lib in that PR: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-mock/pull/112 :thinking:
kev: could be a timeout/regression with the new client. For a quick mitigation can we pin the mocked image in CI to the previous tag and re-run? That should tell us if it's regression vs infra.
sam: I started a canary rerun with the pinned image (job: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/core-integ/7823/1)
ci-bot: rerun triggered by sam — core-integ #7823.1 queued on test-cluster-3
maria: thanks. If that fixes it we should rollback the auth-mock image in the CI manifest and open an issue to bisect the http lib bump. If it doesn't, I'll escalate to infra oncall.
kev: FYI I also saw Redis eviction spikes around the same time, might be correlated resource pressure. I'm watching node metrics.
julie: filing an issue to bisect the dependency bump and assign to @julie + @sam. I'll include the log snippet and the failing junit to help repro.
maria: perfect. For traceability: created a quick checkbox in the incident doc and linked the CI job. If rerun succeeds, we'll roll back the pinned image and run a full matrix later. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: core-integ #7823.1 finished — SUCCESS (15m).
maria: ok great — looks resolved by pinning. I'll follow up with a scheduled bisect and coordinate a proper fix for the http lib bump tomorrow. Thanks all! :rocket:
